body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 6-month rates for a studio at Upside Living – without Burj View:

October: AED 7,800
November: AED 8,900
December: AED 10,000
February: AED 9,500
March: AED 8,500

Please note that a AED 2,000 refundable security deposit is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis (30 nights per month).

To secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and secure the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Here is the link for the apartment. Please note that the rate currently shown online is applicable for September only.

Building name: Upside Living Business Bay

https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-upside-living-2PSudOeqYWO.html

Thank you.
